events.description: 4. ORDER THAT IF PLAINTIFFS SEEK TO PROCEED WITH THIS CASE, THEY MUST, WITHIN THIRTY (30) DAYS OF THE DATE OF THIS ORDER, EITHER (1) PAY $405 (THE $350 FILING FEE AND $55 ADMINISTRATIVE FEE) TO THE CLERK OF COURT, OR (2) REQUEST LEAVE TO PROCEED IN FORMA PAUPERIS. IF PLAINTIFFS PAY THE ENTIRE FEE UPFRONT, ONLY ONE FEE IS REQUIRED, ETC. THE CLERK OF COURT SHALL PROVIDE EACH OF THE PLAINTIFFS WITH AN APPROPRIATE NON-PRISONER APPLICATION TO PROCEED IN FORMA PAUPERIS, BEARING THE CIVIL ACTION NUMBER OF THIS CASE, ETC. SIGNED BY DISTRICT JUDGE JOSEPH F. LEESON, JR ON 11/1/24. 11/1/24 ENTERED AND COPIES E-MAILED. (IFP FORM NOT MAILED). (er) (Entered: 11/01/2024)
